Attached: 3 images

We stuck Minecraft on a kubernetes cluster running on 4 Raspberry Pis in a 3D-Printed case, and then observed it with #opensource.

Why did we do this? Not important: jump to 1:31 to see the Pis: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ojAzsyucJqE
